data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Emmonios', meaning 'strong, powerful'. This name was borne by several early Christian saints, including Emmonios of Cyprus and Emmonios of Egypt. The name Emmons carries the meaning “Strong, powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emmons usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
